items.title: Is that a pterodactyl over Mexico?
items.note: A likely-fake clip of a 'pterodactyl' over a Mexican town has the internet joking that Mexico is now dinosaur country.
items.read: A TikTok posted on November 14 appears to show a pterodactyl flying over a town in Mexico, and Know Your Meme says it hit over 23 million views in five days. Most people assume it's AI-generated or just a big bird. The memes run with it anyway, recaptioning dinosaur scenes from movies and shows as 'Mexico today'.

items.title: 'Huss, huss, huss': everyone parties, he sprints
items.note: The new TikTok slang 'huss' (that sharp sprinting exhale) is now a meme about grinding while the whole town goes out.
items.read: 'Huss' describes the sound of fast, controlled breathing, like a shadowboxer's punch or someone sprinting, and 'hussing' means sprinting or hustling. It took off with the 'Huss Valley' meme in July. This month's version comes from a Roblox clip of a character describing a town where everyone parties but him. Some people are calling it the new '6-7'.

items.title: 'Lucia will appreciate this'
items.note: GTA 6 has you buy groceries and flowers for your girlfriend, and now the pop-up has become a meme format.
items.read: Early in GTA 6 you play as Jason while Lucia waits to get out of prison, and the game suggests things that will make her happy, like buying groceries, getting flowers and fixing up the house. Some players called it a chore simulator, others liked the healthier relationship. Meanwhile the notification box became a template that people fill with absurd tasks.

items.title: GTA 6 players have moved on to goth girl Vicki
items.note: Two days into GTA 6, players have already traded their side-character crush Mandy for goth girl Vicki.
items.read: Dexerto says GTA 6 players are 'already ditching simping for Mandy' in favor of goth girl Vicki. In her mission you help her rob her boss, and afterward she gives you a dance. Judging by the likes, the fandom agrees.

items.title: GTA 6 gets review-bombed anyway
items.note: The biggest launch in entertainment history has a 4.9 user score on Metacritic.
items.read: Culture Crave reports GTA 6 being review-bombed by users on Metacritic, down to a 4.9 user rating. It's landing in the same week the game is breaking sales records, and the contrast has the replies arguing.

items.title: Demiral plants the flag: Ahli vs Nassr aftermath
items.note: Saudi football X is buzzing after Al-Ahli beat Al-Nassr and Demiral planted Ahli's flag at center pitch.
items.read: This post lists everything that happened after the Al-Ahli vs Al-Nassr match. It says Ronaldo threw the captain's armband and was the first player off the pitch. Demiral planted Al-Ahli's flag in the middle of the pitch, which the post calls payback for a Nassr player's flag plant last game. He also gestured at Nassr players and fans to cry and showed off his Elite medal. النصر, رونالدو and الحمدان were all trending in Saudi Arabia this morning.

items.title: Nassr fan wants an official statement… about a flag
items.note: A Nassr fan wants the club to issue an urgent statement holding Demiral accountable for planting a flag, and the replies are loving it.
items.read: In this clip, a Nassr fan asks why Demiral was allowed to plant the flag right in front of them. He calls on Nassr's players and management to put out an urgent statement holding Demiral accountable. Ahli fans are quoting it everywhere as peak post-match salt.

items.title: The horse and dog who stayed on guard
items.note: A man in Brazil fell asleep drunk in the street, and his horse and dog stayed with him until friends found him.
items.read: According to the post, a drunk man in Brazil fell asleep in the middle of the street. His horse and dog stayed by his side until his friends found him. The caption calls it the most valuable wealth a person can have.

items.title: Fighting their inner demons over pasta
items.note: A clip captioned 'They fought their internal demons to keep from eating the pasta.' Self-control has never been this relatable.
items.read: The whole post is one caption: 'They fought their internal demons to keep from eating the pasta.' The replies treat it as a test of willpower that everyone knows they would fail.

items.title: TikTok's Shoulder Carry trend is still climbing
items.note: One friend on the other's shoulders, then the flip on 'cause I'm the one'. It's one of TikTok's top trends today.
items.read: ViralRemix ranks TikTok trends by how many new videos they got in the last day. The Shoulder Carry Trend is #4 today: one person rides on another's shoulders, then they flip on the line 'cause I'm the one'. The Baby Doll line dance is close behind at #5.

items.title: Al Hisn Maze, Riyadh Season
items.note: Brand-new Takeshi's Castle–style obstacle zone that opened yesterday in Dahiat Namar.
items.read: Al Hisn Maze is a first-time Riyadh Season 2026 zone inspired by the 1980s Japanese game show Takeshi's Castle. Players face 12 challenges testing speed, strength and agility before a final Castle round where a champion is crowned. It runs for 29 days with two daily sessions.
items.mapQuery: Al Hisn Maze Dahiat Namar Riyadh

items.title: Ethnosport Cultural Festival, New Murabba
items.note: First edition ever held outside Türkiye, now on at New Murabba for Riyadh Season.
items.read: The Ethnosport Cultural Festival opened at New Murabba, the first time the celebration of traditional sports has been hosted outside Türkiye. More than 18 countries are competing across 38 traditional sports and games, alongside crafts and cuisine. It runs for ten days with daily evening hours.

items.title: Shayan, Al Malqa
items.note: New contemporary Indian spot in Riyadh getting buzz for its pastry-crusted lamb biryani.
items.read: Shayan is a new restaurant in Al Malqa serving Indian favourites with a contemporary twist, from curries and tandoori dishes to creative starters and desserts. Standouts include the Lamb Curry Biryani baked under a golden sesame pastry crust and Sarson Jhinga char-grilled tiger prawns. It's pitched as a good pick for groups who like to share.
items.mapQuery: Shayan Indian restaurant Al Malqa Riyadh

items.title: Global City Dammam, Season 2
items.note: Second season just launched with Dinosaur City and an AI-and-robotics Asian Village.
items.read: Global City Dammam has opened its second season, targeting about 5.2 million visitors after more than three million in season one. New this year are the Asian Village with AI and robotics experiences, and Dinosaur City. The season also brings international pavilions, open-air markets and plenty of food options.

items.title: Golfi at Seven Abha
items.note: New 12-hole interactive mini-golf at Seven's first Saudi entertainment venue.
items.read: Seven Abha now has Golfi, a 12-hole interactive mini-golf experience mixing precision aiming, physical obstacles and interactive designs. Digital scorekeeping replaces the pencil and card. Seven Abha, near Abha International Airport, is owned by Qiddiya Investment Company.

items.title: The Cormorant at 55 South, Chile
items.note: World's southernmost hotel just opened as Silversea's gateway to Antarctica.
items.read: Silversea has opened The Cormorant at 55 South, a 150-room hotel in Puerto Williams, Chile, the southernmost city on Earth. Every passenger on its Antarctica Fly Cruise now flies in on a charter and stays here before continuing south. It's part of a wider trend of cruise lines opening their own land properties.
items.mapQuery: The Cormorant at 55 South Puerto Williams

items.title: Hyatt Vivid Punta Cana
items.note: Hyatt's new adults-only all-inclusive just opened with five pools and a hidden speakeasy.
items.read: Hyatt Vivid Punta Cana, the Vivid brand's Dominican Republic debut, is now open in Cabeza de Toro between the Caribbean Sea and Bávaro Lagoon. The 467-room adults-only all-inclusive has five pools, a food hall, padel and pickleball courts and a spa using Dominican cacao. Swim-out rooms sit in its Vantage Club.

items.title: Starbucks China's viral $24 handbag
items.note: A caramel faux-leather Starbucks bag is selling out in China for looking like Loewe's Flamenco.
items.read: Starbucks China launched a 158-yuan faux-leather handbag last month and it has gone viral on Chinese social media, with shoppers racing to buy it before it sells out. Many say the caramel bag closely resembles Loewe's Flamenco, which costs 23,900 yuan for a medium.

items.title: Huawei OSTA O1 Pro
items.note: First phone from Huawei's new OSTA sub-brand launched with a wide 16:9.5 screen and 200MP camera.
items.read: Huawei launched the OSTA O1 Pro in China, a wide bar phone with a 6.39-inch 16:9.5 display and 1.05mm bezels. It runs Kirin 9030S with a 200MP main camera, a 50MP 3.7x periscope and a 7,000mAh battery. Introductory pricing starts at 5,499 yuan.

items.title: Caitlin Clark's color-changing Nikes
items.note: Viral clip of her Nike Caitlin 1 prototype that switches colors with a button and taps.
items.read: On the Kelce brothers' New Heights podcast, Caitlin Clark showed a color-changing version of her Nike Caitlin 1. A button under the Swoosh activates it, and tapping the shoe cycles through solid black, flashing black and white, and the original white. The clip has gone viral on social media.

items.title: Shedeur Sanders' pink Nike Air DT Max '96
items.note: His Particle Pink PE dropped Friday and fans are scrambling to grab a pair.
items.read: Browns QB Shedeur Sanders' Nike Air DT Max '96 Low edition released on Nov. 20 in Particle Pink with metallic accents. The color drew the most attention online, with fans posting that they'd already ordered.

items.title: Owala x Coca-Cola tumblers return
items.note: Owala brought back its viral Diet Coke tumbler plus three new Coke styles.
items.read: After last year's Target-exclusive Diet Coke collection, Owala and Coca-Cola are back with three new designs plus the returning silver Diet Coke tumbler. The new lineup launched exclusively on Amazon on November 16, including a red Coke tumbler and a vintage 'Ice Cold Coca-Cola' style.

items.title: Mahd Cultural Cafe (مقهى مهد الثقافي)
items.note: A quiet, music-free reading cafe in Al Narjis, with books upstairs, literary events and well-priced V60s.
items.read: Arab News (17 Aug 2026) describes Mahd Cultural Cafe, in Al-Jazli Shopping Mall in Al-Narjis, as a place to slow down with a book. The ground floor is more social; upstairs is a quieter reading room with a curated collection. There is no music, and the cafe also hosts Arabic calligraphy workshops, poetry readings and other literary events, with local art on the walls and Zamzam water available. A private meeting room can be rented. Food is mostly typical cafe bites — the reviewer found the date loaf pleasant but not memorable — while prices stay reasonable: a Spanish latte or V60 is SR19, and matcha is SR24. An Exa place listing rates it 4.6 from 568 reviews.
facts: Sun–Wed and Sat 6 a.m.–midnight; Thu–Fri 7 a.m.–1 a.m. (Exa listing)
Spanish latte or V60 SR19; matcha SR24 (Arab News)
Quiet reading space, no music, literary events
items.mapQuery: Mahd Cultural Cafe Al Narjis Riyadh

items.title: 3gd Café (عقد)
items.note: A tiny, home-like cafe on Ibn Khaldun Street in Ar Rawdah, set in a converted house with vintage furniture and a must-try date cake.
items.read: LIST (24 Apr 2025) writes that 3gd — pronounced eqd — sits on the ground floor of a residential building on Ibn Khaldun Street in Ar Rawdah and feels like visiting a friend’s home. It is small, with just ten tables (five indoors, five outdoors), a rug at the garden entrance, plants, and a wooden cabinet of the sort you’d find in a grandmother’s house. The menu is simple: basil or mint tea, two coffees, iced coffee, iced tea, hibiscus, and baked goods including a date cake the reviewer called a must-try. This is Riyadh (18 Jul 2024) adds that the family kept the house’s antique furniture, praises the Americano, mint tea, karkadeh, V60 and iced drip (about SR7–16), and singles out a soft Beehive pastry and fudgy brownies. A Yango Maps listing I opened rates it 4.8 from 21 reviews — a small sample — at RFRA6657, Ibn Khaldun Street, and on Saturday 21 Nov 2026 it showed the cafe closed until 4 p.m. It is a different spot from On, also on Ibn Khaldun Street, which appeared in an earlier digest.
facts: RFRA6657, Ibn Khaldun Street, Ar Rawdah (Yango Maps)
Date cake, Beehive pastry, homey vintage interiors
items.mapQuery: 3gd Cafe Ibn Khaldun Ar Rawdah Riyadh

items.title: Filtro Cafe (فلترو كافيه)
items.note: A neighborhood specialty cafe in Al Aqiq, praised for its V60s, sweets and friendly baristas, with a strong rating and a modest review count.
items.read: An Exa place listing for Filtro Cafe at Aws Ibn Awf in Al Aqiq rates the Riyadh branch 4.7 from 237 reviews. Reviewers highlight V60s brewed with the house beans, sweets, a cozy atmosphere and notably friendly staff, and one Arabic review treated the Riyadh opening as long-awaited. The listing’s hours are 6 a.m. to midnight most days, 12:30 p.m. to 1 a.m. on Friday, and 4 p.m. to midnight on Saturday. The cafe’s own site, which I opened, describes a specialty shop for hot and cold coffee, desserts and food, with an emphasis on local products. (Filtro also has a separately listed Al-Kharj branch; the details here are for the Al Aqiq, Riyadh location.)
facts: Sun–Thu 6 a.m.–midnight; Fri 12:30 p.m.–1 a.m.; Sat 4 p.m.–midnight (Exa listing)
items.mapQuery: Filtro Cafe Aws Ibn Awf Al Aqiq Riyadh

items.title: Prime Cup (برايم كب)
items.note: A 24-hour specialty-coffee window in Al Wadi with a striking 4.9 rating and almost all five-star reviews.
items.read: Prime Cup is a specialty-coffee shop on Wadi As Sarh in Al Wadi. An Exa place listing rates it 4.9 from 117 reviews and lists it as open 24 hours, with phone number 053 993 2383. Listah, updated 19 Nov 2026, shows 4.9 from 120 Google reviews over 12 months, with 98% five-star, and ranks it 16th among 196 specialty-coffee spots in Riyadh. Reviewers on Listah repeatedly mention specialty coffee. The storefront photo on that Listah page shows a compact, well-lit pickup window under a Prime Cup / قهوة مختصة sign.
facts: QMPV+4P2, Wadi As Sarh, Al Wadi
4.9 from 117 reviews (Exa); Listah shows 4.9 from 120 Google reviews

items.title: Najd Roastery (محمصة نجد)
items.note: A spacious specialty roastery in An Narjis, liked for Spanish lattes, flat whites, coconut cake and date pudding.
items.read: An Exa place listing puts Najd Roastery at RMHQ+QHW, Dhalam, An Narjis, and rates it 4.5 from 305 reviews, with hours of 6 a.m. to midnight most days and noon to midnight on Friday. Zubdah’s summary of visitor reviews (7.4/10 from 228 ratings, 82% positive) praises the specialty coffee, a creamy Spanish latte, a well-made flat white, and desserts, especially coconut cake and date pudding, plus Ethiopian and Indonesian beans sold to take home. Reviewers also mention a calm, roomy interior and outdoor seating, a modern Najdi feel, and match screens. The main caveats are mid-range prices and occasional inconsistency between drinks. These details are for the An Narjis location; similarly named roasteries appear in other districts.
facts: Sun–Thu and Sat 6 a.m.–midnight; Fri noon–midnight (Exa listing)
Spanish latte, flat white, coconut cake, date pudding
items.mapQuery: Najd Roastery Dhalam An Narjis Riyadh

items.title: Kando
items.note: A free, open-source pie menu for Windows, macOS and Linux that turns app launches and shortcuts into muscle-memory gestures.
items.read: Kando’s official site describes a cross-platform pie menu for launching apps, running macros, opening files and triggering shortcuts, designed to be used with a mouse, stylus, touch or a controller. Items live in fixed wedges, including nested menus, so you can select them by direction rather than hunting through a taskbar. The project is free and open source, with no telemetry or cloud account, and the site highlights custom themes, sound packs, context-aware menus that change with the active app, and multi-step workflows. MakeUseOf (13 Sep 2026) called it MIT-licensed and noted recent additions such as keyboard navigation and a portable mode, with some extra setup possible on Linux Wayland.
facts: Free and open source (MIT, per MakeUseOf)

items.title: AltSnap
items.note: A small Windows utility that lets you move a window with Alt+left-drag and resize it with Alt+right-drag, from anywhere inside the window.
items.read: AltSnap is a maintained continuation of AltDrag for Windows. Its official GitHub wiki, which I opened, explains the basic trick: Alt+left-click moves a window from anywhere inside it, and Alt+right-click resizes toward the nearest edge or corner, so you no longer have to aim at a thin title bar or border. It also mimics Aero Snap at screen edges and corners, magnet-snaps window borders, and offers transparency, multi-monitor tweaks and a tray icon that can be left-clicked to disable the hook before a game. Installers are listed via GitHub Releases, Chocolatey, winget and Scoop, and a portable zip is available. MakeUseOf (13 Sep 2026) describes it as GPL-licensed and still regularly updated.
facts: Alt-drag move and resize, snapping, portable build

items.title: Aves
items.note: An open-source Android gallery that treats your library as a metadata explorer, not just a camera roll, and still handles odd formats like SVG and GeoTIFF.
items.read: Aves, by Thibault Deckers, is a gallery and metadata explorer for Android. The Google Play listing I opened (4.3 from about 4,460 reviews) and the F-Droid page for Aves Libre describe an app that handles everyday JPEGs and MP4s plus multi-page TIFFs, SVGs, older AVIs, motion photos, panoramas, 360° video and GeoTIFF, and lets you move between albums, tags and maps. It can also act as a viewer, picker, widget, screensaver and Android TV app. F-Droid lists version 1.15.10 as added on 13 Nov 2026, under a BSD 3-Clause license; that build adds C2PA detection and inspection. A Google Play build is available alongside the libre F-Droid package.
facts: Android (also Android TV); Android 7+ on F-Droid

items.title: DeskBox
items.note: A young, GPL-licensed Windows desktop organizer that groups files in on-desktop widgets without moving them out of ordinary folders.
items.read: DeskBox is a free, open-source Windows 10/11 desktop organizer, built with WinUI 3, that sits on the normal desktop instead of replacing it. File widgets can point at regular folders, so File Explorer still sees the same files in the same place. The official site I opened also describes stack-and-group layouts, task and notes widgets, music controls, and capsules that collapse when you’re not using them. MakeUseOf (13 Sep 2026) notes that the first public test only appeared in June 2026, so the project is still young and some behavior may change; the official homepage was featuring version 1.5.7, with a native AOT installer and an English screenshot I opened.

items.title: Thorium Reader
items.note: A free, accessibility-minded reader from the non-profit EDRLab for ebooks, audiobooks, comics and manga, with no store lock-in.
items.read: Thorium Reader’s official site describes a free reading app maintained by EDRLab, a non-profit that works on open reading standards. You bring your own files: EPUB (reflowable and fixed-layout), PDF, CBZ, and audiobooks in formats such as MP3, M4B and FLAC, including Readium LCP titles from libraries and retailers. Features include adjustable type, themes, 10+ fonts, a listen-aloud button, full keyboard navigation, and support for JAWS, NVDA, Narrator and VoiceOver. It runs on Windows 10+, macOS 12+, several Linux distributions, and iPhone or iPad on iOS/iPadOS 26, and can be used offline after a book is downloaded. MakeUseOf (13 Sep 2026) recommended it as a focused reading app alongside a library manager such as Calibre.
facts: EPUB, PDF, CBZ, audiobooks; Readium LCP
